seo.title: Careers
seo.openRolesDescription: Explore open roles at Arg Software and apply to join an architecture-first engineering team building complex production systems.
seo.noRolesDescription: Arg Software is not hiring today. Learn what we look for in architecture-first engineers and how to reach the founders directly.

hero.openRolesSubtitle: Every role is scoped for meaningful ownership on production systems. No hiring theatre, no filler seats.
hero.noRolesSubtitle: We are not hiring for a specific role today, but we still want to hear from engineers who think like us. The next opening is often shaped around someone we already know.

roles.title: The team is
roles.subtitle: Focused openings across engineering, infrastructure, product, security, and data. Each one is built for senior contributors with a direct feedback loop.

hiring.title: How we
hiring.subtitle: Four steps. No take-home puzzles, no ghost stages. We move fast when we find the right person.

who.title: Not hiring today. But here's
who.subtitle: We stay intentionally small and selective. If this sounds like the kind of team where you would do your best work, reach out early - the right conversations are worth having before a role exists.

founders.title: We're small.
founders.intro: No recruiter wall, no ATS black hole. If you think you'd fit at ARG, the fastest way in is a short note to one of us.
